purpose: Attack the v8.2 partial-splice frontier before building larger macro networks. The key simplification is that the 18 full proper-colouring states of a terminal C4 are not all externally observable: every future source splice touches only dangling ports {0,2,3}. Quotient by equality on those three exposed colours. The quotient has exactly 12 states, admits an exact {E,A} x S3 parameterization, and is a congruence for the v7.9 wire and for every one-edge, two-edge, or full three-edge physical splice. Enumerate all partial splice atoms in this smaller exact language.

exposed_boundary.state: q(c)=(c0,c2,c3). Properness of the C4 implies c0!=c3 and c2!=c3; there is no direct edge between ports 0 and 2.

fiber_structure_from_18_full_C4_states.E_sector: If c0=c2, then port 1 may be either of the two colours different from c0. There are six exposed E states, each with two full-state lifts.
fiber_structure_from_18_full_C4_states.A_sector: If c0!=c2, then c0,c2,c3 are all distinct and port 1 is forced to c3. There are six exposed A states, each with one full-state lift.

sectors.E: rho_E=(0,0,1): the two opposite exposed ports 0 and 2 are equal.
sectors.A: rho_A=(0,1,2): all three exposed colours are distinct.

sector_S3_normal_form.unique_gauge: S3 acts freely on both rho_E and rho_A, so every exposed state is uniquely (sector,g) in {E,A} x S3.
sector_S3_normal_form.ordered_pair_form: Equivalently choose distinct colours u=c0 and v=c3 plus one bit b. For b=0 (E), c2=u. For b=1 (A), c2 is the unique third colour -u-v in GF(3). Thus the exposed state space is a Boolean switch times one ordered colour frame.

wire_congruence.statement: The v7.9 full-state permutation F descends exactly to a 12-state boundary permutation T; two 18-state lifts with the same exposed triple always have the same exposed output triple.
explicit_map: If u,w,v are all distinct, T(u,w,v)=(w,v,u) in sector A.
wire_congruence.sector_gain_form: With tuple composition p*q meaning p after q and r=(1,2,0), T(E,g)=(E,g) and T(A,g)=(A,g*r). Hence T has six fixed E states and two 3-cycles on the six A states; T^3=id.
wire_congruence.witness_lifting: Given any accepted 12-state wire/splice assignment, choose an arbitrary compatible full lift in every E fiber (A fibers are unique), apply the original v7.9 full-state wire witness table, and reconstruct hidden C4 colours. External splice legality is unchanged because it depends only on ports 0,2,3.

single_splice_edge_theorem.model: Join one exposed port p of the left wire output terminal to one exposed port q of the right wire input terminal by a Hamiltonian edge, imposing one colour inequality.
single_splice_edge_theorem.relative_gain: For fixed left/right sectors, write h=g_R^{-1}g_L. The splice forbids exactly the two permutations h in S3 that map the relevant left canonical port colour to the relevant right canonical port colour. Therefore exactly four gains remain for each of the four sector pairs.
single_splice_edge_theorem.consequence: Every one-edge partial splice has exactly 16 quotient triples (sector_L,sector_R,h), equivalently 96 ordered pairs on the 12-state boundary after restoring the six global colour gauges.

exact_partial_splice_catalog.definition: For k in {1,2,3}, choose k distinct ports from {0,2,3} on each side and a bijection between them; add those k physical NEQ edges. Outer states are the exposed state before the left wire and after the right wire.

k3.crosscheck_with_v8_0: The two port permutations that produced 132 full 18-state pairs in v8.0 collapse to 54 exposed-state pairs; the four 84-pair relations collapse to 42. The quotient is exact because the discarded port-1 choice is never touched by a splice.

main_theorem.name: EXPOSED_PORT_EQUIVALENCE_IS_AN_EXACT_CONGRUENCE_FOR_THE_V7_9_WIRE_AND_ALL_PARTIAL_SPLICES
main_theorem.statement: For every finite network built from the v7.9 smooth four-C4 wire and physical Hamiltonian splice edges that touch only its three designated dangling ports per terminal, satisfiability and boundary witness reconstruction are unchanged when every 18-state terminal variable is replaced by its 12-state exposed triple q(c)=(c0,c2,c3). In {E,A} x S3 coordinates, the wire is identity on E and a fixed order-three gain transport on A; each physical splice edge is one two-element forbidden S3 coset conditioned on the endpoint sectors.
proof: Enumerate all eighteen proper labelled C4 colourings and project to ports 0,2,3. The image contains exactly twelve triples with the stated 2/1 fiber sizes.

Apply the exact v7.9 permutation F to all eighteen states. Within each projection fiber the exposed image is identical, giving the explicit T map; therefore the projection is a congruence for every wire factor.
Every new physical splice constraint is an inequality between two exposed port colours, so it is constant on projection fibers and therefore also respects the quotient.

Conversely every exposed state has at least one full lift. Since wire and splice acceptance are fiber-invariant, a satisfying exposed assignment lifts factor-by-factor to the original full interface and then to the stored hidden witnesses.
The checker independently exhausts all 9 one-edge, 18 two-edge and 6 three-edge port matchings and freezes the exact relation cardinalities above.

positive: Shrinks the only currently live partial-splice boundary domain from 18 to 12 states without approximation or loss of witnesses.

Replaces the old three-orbit description by a sharper Boolean-sector plus S3-gauge description: tau0 and tau1 are externally indistinguishable at the exposed interface and merge into E; tau2 becomes A.
Gives a complete constant catalog of every one-edge and two-edge splice atom before any high-degree macro network search.
Explains the remaining branching algebraically: each physical edge merely removes one size-two evaluation coset from S3 for each sector pair.
firewall: A 12-state finite-domain CSP on a high-degree macro interaction graph is not automatically polynomial. The v8.1 path/cycle terminal does not extend merely because the domain is smaller.
The quotient is proved only for compositions through the designated exposed ports {0,2,3}; same-C4 Hamiltonian diagonals or gadgets that expose port 1 require a new interface proof.
No claim is made that the Boolean sector can be solved independently of the S3 gauge; cycle holonomy may couple them.
This is not a universal SAT algorithm and does not imply P=NP.

next_target.name: E8_SECTOR_S3_PARTIAL_SPLICE_BRANCHING_CLOSURE_V8_3
next_target.directive: Work only in the exact 12-state quotient. Treat every v7.9 wire as T(E,g)=(E,g), T(A,g)=(A,g*r) and every one/two-edge physical splice as the frozen forbidden-coset relation from v8.2. First test whether projecting the S3 layer yields a tractable Boolean sector CSP and whether the conditioned gauge constraints form a polynomial gain/list-homomorphism class. Mandatory hard controls are a terminal whose three dangling ports split across three distinct neighbours, cycles with mixed E/A sectors, the v8.0 four-output branching witness, and the v8.1 full-splice path/cycle terminal. Do not return to 18-state enumeration unless a gadget exposes port 1.
